title: The Ducklings
offer: We found seven ducklings in Stormvik harbour, without their mother! Grim says a duck with no ducklings swims sadly in his swan cove. Can you bring them to her?

steps.load_say: Peep, peep! They are in a basket with some straw. Hurry!
steps.say: Look: the duck swims to them, and they all paddle after her in a line. Seven! Ha!
They found their mother? Hooray! You are the best.

fact: Ducklings follow the first one they see after hatching, usually their mother.
